request.description: Transparent pixel-art atlas, EXACTLY 4 columns by 3 rows of64x64 cells, 12 isolated game props, each inside its cell with8px clear padding. No grid, letters or numbers. Match attached quiet low-poly village props: grey-brown timber, muted grey-green metal, faded ochre paper, matte grey-blue cloth, two or three broad flat tones per material, restrained contrast, no black outline, no dithering, no tiny scratches, no texture noise, no shiny highlights, NO environmental backgrounds or baked shadows. Orthographic view from above38degrees unless stated face-on. Row1 left to right: one short wooden-handled iron smith hammer lying diagonally; one pair of broad iron tongs lying flat slightly open; a low pile of four chunky grey metal offcuts; one rectangular faded paper village map with three plain block building symbols and one wide winding path, FACE ON flat paper with no text. Row2: two small overlapping plain faded paper notices FACE ON; one simple small red-brown square wax seal FACE ON; one squat rolled muted blue-grey travel bedding tied with a brown strap; one simple squat beige clay travel water flask with a stopper and brown shoulder strap. Row3: one neatly coiled tan rope viewed from above; one low shallow tan wicker basket with no tiny weaving lines; one shallow muted beige ceramic bowl viewed from above; one circular wooden jar lid viewed from above with two broad boards and a short crossbar. Separate readable plain silhouettes; these are small scenery props for an old mountain village, not collectible UI icons. Keep each sprite near cell center and not touching adjacent cells.

notes: 승인된 시설 소품·원정 준비물·부엌 소품을 한 시트로 생성했다. 바닥 흔적과 야생 버섯은 기존 이미지를 재사용한다. 원본 RGBA는 수정하지 않고 12칸의 투명 여백만 추출했다. 소품은 장식이며 새 채집·보상 규칙은 없다.
